description.en: Our skull is made up of 22 bones. With age and improper posture, the gaps between the bones continue to widen, resulting in facial misalignment. This gentle, hands-on treatment corrects gaps between bones and repositions bone collaterals to achieve a natural, refined appearance.
description.zh: 我們頭骨由22塊骨塊組成。隨著年齡增長和不良姿勢，骨塊間的缝隙不斷加濶，導致面部歪斜與不對稱。日式小顏矯正通過最自然、最安全的專業手感，改善面部骨骼間的缝隙，塑造臉部輪廓，達至小顏與提拉效果。

benefits.en: Promotes a more lifted and refined appearance.
benefits.zh: 面部提拉與收緊，重塑精緻臉廓。
調整左右臉對稱度，使五官更均勻。

benefits.en: Helps reduce the appearance of puffiness & swelling.
benefits.zh: 促進淋巴與血液循環，快速減輕面部水腫。

benefits.en: Supports a fresher, more rejuvenated skin look.
benefits.zh: 改善血流代謝，使皮膚煥發自然光澤。

benefits.en: Encourages deep relaxation and release of facial tension.
benefits.zh: 深層放鬆面部肌肉，釋放生活壓力。

benefits.en: Supports overall wellbeing and jaw opening alignment.
benefits.zh: 調整顎骨平衡，使牙關咬合開合更順暢。
